svg.title: Cross-section climb: Geological survey section
svg.desc: Cross-section climb (2D): the mountain is cut open like a survey section, its strata hatched in rock patterns, with the altitude scale on the left. Lira's dotted route climbs from the base camp through a shaft and up the ledges; she has clipped her anchor in as a storm front crosses the slope at 3,400 m. Her air bar is draining, and above the 4,000 m line the low-gravity pockets shimmer, with the next camp beyond them.
svg.text: SECTION A-A' BOOK III CLIMB 2 800 to 4 600 m ROUTE IN JOURNAL INK
